anomalies: LOW ROW COUNT IS EXPLAINED BY A ONE-DAY WINDOW, not by a failed sweep. Stated explicitly because six rows against last week's 88 would otherwise read as a broken run.

COVERAGE GAP IN THE PREVIOUS DAY'S RUNS: all five runs of 2026-08-09 recorded Environment Agency as checked but were working from the 24-30 July edition. The 31 July to 6 August edition had been on GOV.UK since 7 August. The manifest's last_publication field for that source still read 2026-07-31, which is what surfaced the gap; it has been corrected to 2026-08-07.

REUTERS AND BLOOMBERG ARE NOT REACHABLE by this agent's fetch and search tools (reuters.com returns a user-agent block). Both are named in STEP 3 pass 2. Coverage of those desks is therefore indirect, via syndication on brecorder.com, palmoilmagazine.com and similar. This is a standing limitation, not a one-off.
